instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/task-038_initial.scad in OpenSCAD and edit it while preserving the initial right-angle bracket: the base plate occupies x=[-50,50], y=[-30,30], z=[0,5] mm and the upright plate occupies x=[-50,50], y=[25,30], z=[5,40] mm. Add exactly five equally spaced triangular reinforcing ribs with X centers at -40,-20,0,20,40 mm (20 mm center spacing). Each rib is a 3 mm extrusion along X, so its X range is [center_x-1.5,center_x+1.5]. Before union with the bracket, define each rib's right-triangle cross-section in the Y-Z plane by the three vertices (0,4), (28,4), and (28,36) mm. Thus each rib is 28 mm deep in +Y and 32 mm high in +Z. This placement gives a 1 mm overlap with the base plate across z=[4,5] and a 3 mm overlap with the upright plate across y=[25,28]; use union() so the plates and all five ribs form one connected solid. Export /home/user/Desktop/task-038_output.stl. [Software] To use OpenSCAD, run `openscad` from a terminal.
